name: CapInteract LP Interact

web.notes: White-label investor portal under the administrator's brand. Vendor says MFA applies everywhere a human signs in; factor types not stated.

api.notes: No API described on the vendor home page. Separate Ci Data Platform is a read-only data layer over existing ledgers for the administrator.

notes: White-label client platform sold to fund administrators. LP Interact is the investor portal: each investor sees only their own capital accounts, statements and fund performance; content approved by the administrator and logged. Sibling products GP Interact, Ci Data Platform, Guardian Interact. Runs over Investran, eFront, Allvue or an in-house ledger. SOC 2 Type II per vendor. Deployment: Apex Group states its 'Apex investor portal' is powered by CapInteract (high confidence). Vendor HQ Waterford, US with engineering in Belgrade, Serbia (medium confidence, vendor page only). Ownership not stated.
